connectivity.name: connectivity
connectivity.error: Staging Redis URL does not use TLS (rediss://). Pass allow_insecure=True only for local mock tests.

failure_details: connectivity: Staging Redis URL does not use TLS (rediss://). Pass allow_insecure=True only for local mock tests.
environmental_context: Current free-tier Redis environment provides redis:// without TLS termination. Real Redis functional behavior is proven; infrastructure capabilities (TLS, HA, scale, backups, private networking) remain deferred/unproven and are preserved as future validation targets.

redis_functional_semantics.evidence: Queue lifecycle, atomic leasing, retry schedule, dead-letter routing, and zombie recovery proven against real Redis instance (server version 8.6.2 at treatment-fuel-wool-75256.db.redis.io:13859).

redis_native_lua_execution.evidence: CLAIM_JOB_LUA and ENQUEUE_JOB_LUA executed natively in real Redis engine with atomic concurrency limits and deduplication.

redis_checkpoint_semantics.evidence: LangGraph BaseCheckpointSaver protocol, exact state round-trip, thread isolation, forbidden secret rejection, and thread deletion proven against real Redis.

redis_arq_serialization_compatibility.evidence: review_job_task payload serialized with installed ARQ 0.28.0 and round-trip deserialized.

redis_secret_handling.evidence: Complete credential masking verified in URLs, metadata representations, and keyspace.

redis_tls_transport.reason: Current free-tier Redis environment provides redis:// rather than rediss://. TLS transport is unavailable on this free-tier provider endpoint.
redis_tls_transport.future_target: Validate rediss:// transport against TLS-capable staging/production Redis endpoint.

redis_ha_failover.reason: Current free-tier Redis environment is a single standalone node without Sentinel or Redis Cluster failover semantics.
redis_ha_failover.future_target: Validate failover and reconnection against multi-node/HA Redis deployment.

production_scale_capacity.reason: Free-tier environment has strict throughput/connection limits unsuitable for load testing.
production_scale_capacity.future_target: Benchmark sustained concurrency and load on production-provisioned Redis.

managed_production_backups_recovery.reason: Free-tier Redis instance does not provide managed point-in-time recovery or backup guarantees.
managed_production_backups_recovery.future_target: Verify snapshot/RDB/AOF persistence and recovery on managed infrastructure.

private_production_networking.reason: Current free-tier Redis is hosted on public endpoint with authentication; VPC peering / private networking is not present in free tier.
private_production_networking.future_target: Validate VPC peering / private Link / internal subnet connectivity.

modular_production_path.architecture_invariance: Transition between unencrypted free-tier Redis and future TLS-capable Redis is 100% configuration-driven via REDIS_URL. No business logic, queue semantics, checkpoint semantics, or adapter architecture changes are required.
modular_production_path.engineering_conclusion: Redis functional behavior is proven against real Redis; infrastructure capabilities unavailable in the current free-tier environment remain deferred/unproven and are preserved as future validation targets.
